about_the_game:
Game Introduction

《Mirror of the Phantom Maiden》

This is a solo-developed game created using Unreal Engine.
In a mirror world where day and night collapse, the protagonist Rin searches for the truth behind her sister’s disappearance.
A side-scrolling horror adventure about repression, fear, and redemption.

Gameplay

Mirror of the Phantom Maiden is a side-scrolling supernatural mystery adventure.
Players will travel between reality and a mirror world, uncovering the truth behind a disappearance through exploration, puzzle-solving, and exorcism.
Blending psychological suspense with Japanese spiritual horror elements, the game offers a deeply narrative-driven experience.

Day-Night Shift System

Investigate clues hidden in the school during the day, then descend into the “Phantom Mirror Realm” at night to confront lost memories and strange phenomena.
Interactions between day and night worlds will influence story progression and scene changes.

Mirror World Puzzle Exploration

Each mirror domain represents repressed memories and emotions.
Collect items, reconstruct clues, use spiritual charms, and interact with the environment to reveal the secrets of the past.

Story Background

Rin’s sister has mysteriously disappeared on the school campus.
The official report claims she “may have gone missing in the back mountain,”
but no body was ever found, and the case was swiftly buried.

Now, Rin transfers to the school her sister once attended,
determined to uncover what really happened.
In this seemingly peaceful campus,
she will uncover layers of silence, denial, and forgotten truths—
and begin to suspect her sister’s disappearance wasn’t an accident.
Perhaps something unnatural exists within the school.

Rumors say whispers echo at night,
and the mirrors reflect those who shouldn’t be there.
